mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM applications a WHERE a.space_id = #{spaceId} AND a.event_id = #{eventId} AND a.participant_id = #{participantId} AND a.status = 'SUBMITTED') AS active, coalesce(( SELECT gp.snapshot @> jsonb_build_object('groups', jsonb_build_array( jsonb_build_object('members', jsonb_build_array( jsonb_build_object('participantId', CAST(#{participantId} AS text), 'leader', true))))) FROM group_publications gp WHERE gp.space_id = #{spaceId} AND gp.event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY gp.seq DESC LIMIT 1), false) AS leader

SELECT p.id FROM participants p WHERE p.space_id = #{spaceId} AND p.event_id = #{eventId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM applications a WHERE a.space_id = p.space_id AND a.event_id = p.event_id AND a.participant_id = p.id AND a.status = 'SUBMITTED') ORDER BY p.id

SELECT DISTINCT p.id FROM ( SELECT gp.snapshot FROM group_publications gp WHERE gp.space_id = #{spaceId} AND gp.event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY gp.seq DESC LIMIT 1) latest CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(latest.snapshot -> 'groups') g CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(g -> 'members') m JOIN participants p ON p.space_id = #{spaceId} AND p.event_id = #{eventId} AND p.id::text = m ->> 'participantId' WHERE m -> 'leader' = 'true'::jsonb AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM applications a WHERE a.space_id = p.space_id AND a.event_id = p.event_id AND a.participant_id = p.id AND a.status = 'SUBMITTED') ORDER BY p.id
